article.headline: Coltie Young scores 27 to help UL Monroe end 10-game skid with 77-66 victory over South Alabama
article.description: — Coltie Young had 27 points to help UL Monroe snap a 10-game losing streak with a 77-66 victory over South Alabama on Monday night.
article.linkText: Coltie Young scores 27 to help UL Monroe end 10-game skid with 77-66 victory over South Alabama
article.story: MONROE, La. -- — Coltie Young had 27 points to help UL Monroe snap a 10-game losing streak with a 77-66 victory over South Alabama on Monday night. Young also had seven rebounds for the Warhawks (5-17, 1-8 Sun Belt Conference). Makai Willis made all nine of his free throws and scored 17, adding seven rebounds and three blocks. Jalen Bolden made three 3-pointers and scored 12. The Jaguars (14-7, 6-3) were led by Dylan Fasoyiro with 15 points. Myles Corey totaled 14 points and seven assist. John Broom scored 12. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
